body.query: Which candidates know Python and AWS and have at least 5 years of experience?
body.refined_query: Which candidates know Python and AWS and have at least 5 years of experience?
body.response:
The candidates who know Python and AWS and have at least 5 years of experience are:

- Oliver Schmidt — 10 years
- Arjun Malhotra — 7 years
- Rohan Deshpande — 15 years
- Aarav Mehta — 8 years
- Nadia Haddad — 9 years
- Rahul Verma — 5 years
- Anjali Nair — 6 years
- Siddharth Rao — 13 years

data.title: r14-oliver-schmidt.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Oliver Schmidt, presenting his background and impact as an MLOps leader. It highlights 10 years of experience taking ML and LLM services from development to production on AWS and GCP, including building feature store and model registry using Kubeflow and MLflow. It also lists his professional roles, core skills, certifications, languages, and education.

data.title: r16-arjun-malhotra.pdf
data.context: The resume describes Arjun Malhotra as a Senior AI Engineer with 7 years of experience, including building Python backends and shipping LLM applications. It highlights his work on retrieval-augmented generation over legal documents, agent workflows, and LLM evaluation pipelines, along with prior backend engineering in a SaaS context. The document also lists his education, skills, certification, languages, and contact/location details.

data.title: r18-rohan-deshpande.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Rohan Deshpande, presenting his profile as a Principal Data Engineer and data platform architect with 15 years of experience designing lakehouse and streaming platforms on AWS and Azure. It details his education, progressive work experience across energy and telecom companies, and lists relevant technical skills, certifications, and languages.

data.title: r01-aarav-mehta.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Aarav Mehta, a senior machine learning engineer focused on AWS-based production systems. It highlights 8 years of experience building recommendation/ranking and LLM-powered retrieval (RAG) solutions, including improving hallucination rates and fine-tuning models for customer support. The resume lists skills, certifications, work experience across Lumora Commerce and Brightpath Lending, and education (M.Tech and B.E.).

data.title: r19-nadia-haddad.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Nadia Haddad, a senior site reliability engineer with 9 years of experience running Kubernetes platforms on GCP and AWS and leading incident response for logistics systems. It details her skills, certifications (CKA and Google Cloud DevOps), work experience at Sandpiper Logistics and Oasisnet Hosting, and her B.Sc. in Computer Science from Levant Polytechnic University.

data.title: r05-rahul-verma.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Rahul Verma, a DevOps engineer with 5 years of experience automating AWS infrastructure using Terraform and operating Kubernetes platforms for SaaS products. It outlines his work running EKS and Terraform infrastructure, improving monitoring/alerting with Prometheus and Grafana, and maintaining CI/CD and server configuration using Jenkins and Ansible. The resume includes his B.Tech education, contact details, listed skills, certifications, and languages.

data.title: r11-anjali-nair.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Anjali Nair, a senior data engineer with 6 years of experience building batch and streaming data pipelines. It highlights her work on AWS/Snowflake/Airflow-based logistics and SaaS data platforms, including Kafka/Spark streaming into Snowflake and improvements from introducing dbt models and data contracts. It also lists her education, contact details, skills, certifications, and languages.

data.title: r22-siddharth-rao.pdf
data.context: The resume describes Siddharth Rao, a Staff Machine Learning Engineer with 13 years of experience, focused on recommender systems and (since 2023) LLM and RAG systems. The document also lists relevant skills, languages, and an M.S. in Computer Science.
